items.text:
Game in NOT finished and still buggy as hell, you WILL encounter game breaking and save game ruining bugs. Game is  at best v0.16 or v0.2 and is defintely not a fully released version. I always supported the dev.....til now, this release just REEKS of "game is finished, peace out im done" that most devs do when their unfinished games are released. Dev "may" keep working on it, but now that its released he can just abandon it like every other dev has done in this same exact situation. It happens thousands of times a year on Steam, so no surprised it happened again. utter dissapointment.

Edit - developer and their forum mod friends are actively banning and removing any negative comments, Blue Bottle Games have shown they dont care about the community, merely releasing the game so they can abandon it. IF the game was really ready for a V1 release WHY are there still so many bugs and problems with the game? Becuase its not finished, will be "worked" on for a bit then abandoned like their last game.
items.text_zh:
游戏并没有完成，而且仍然bug多得像地狱，你一定会遇到破坏游戏和毁掉存档的bug。游戏最多也就是v0.16或v0.2，绝对不是完整发布的版本。我一直支持开发者……直到现在，这次发布简直散发着“游戏完成了， peace out，我完事了”的恶臭，大多数开发者在他们未完成的游戏发布时都会这么做。开发者“可能”会继续做下去，但现在既然已经发布了，他就可以像其他每个开发者在这种完全相同的情况下所做的那样直接抛弃它。这种事在Steam上一年发生成千上万次，所以再次发生也不奇怪。彻底的失望。

编辑——开发者和他们论坛版主朋友们正在积极封禁和删除任何负面评论，Blue Bottle Games已经表明他们不在乎社区，只是发布游戏以便抛弃它。如果游戏真的准备好发布V1，为什么还有这么多bug和问题？因为它没有完成，会被“处理”一阵子，然后像他们上一款游戏一样被抛弃。
